svg.title: Which model and effort settings public benchmarks say are worth trying
svg.text: What public benchmarks say, per quota pool. Each bar runs from the lowest to the highest effort level.
Best mix of speed and intelligence
Long agentic coding and knowledge work
Scores less than 3 points (21 Elo) apart count as a tie, and the cheaper setting wins. Settings are compared only inside one benchmark from one source.
“Cheaper” means a lower API cost per task on that benchmark, which only approximates quota use. Reasons and sources: the tables under this chart.
Offered but never measured: minimal (GPT-5.6 Terra); ultra (GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Astra).
